prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Select a ready-to-adopt companion or design a custom pet from your photos."]
1: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Companion", "Connect your account so your pet profile and desktop data stay safely synced."]
2: ["Confirm Pet Adoption Details", "Review your companion details and confirm official registration."]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival", "We are generating and loading your pet companion files now."]
4: ["Your Desktop Pet is Active", "Your companion is live on your desktop. Learn how to interact with it below."]
5: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Adopt a pre-made pet in seconds or create a custom companion from your photos.", "Start Setup"]
6: ["Use the same sign-in provider you used previously to restore existing pets."]
7: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use well-lit, front-facing photos of your pet for best custom 3D generation results.", "Avoid blurry pictures or extreme angles for optimal accuracy."]
8: ["Generating Your Pet Assets"]
9: ["Your Companion is Ready", "Right-click your pet on the desktop to open settings, chat, or temporarily hide it.", "Launch Companion"]
